copy.tagline: 自动执行 Affinity 中的重复性客户管理任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Affinity 中手动更新记录或跟进客户
copy.tagline_en: Automate repetitive customer management tasks in Affinity
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manually update records or follow up leads in Affinity

howto.what: 安装了此技能后，Claude 可以通过 Rube MCP 自动执行 Affinity 任务（如管理联系人、工作流）。操作前必须先用 RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS 搜索最新工具，再用 RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS 确认连接状态，最后用 RUBE_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL 执行具体操作。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 在 Affinity 中执行自动化操作（例如创建联系人、更新组织信息）时触发。系统会自动先搜索工具、检查连接，再执行。

say.text: 帮我自动化Affinity中的联系人创建
批量更新Affinity中的组织信息
查看Affinity中我的工作流列表

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can automate Affinity tasks (e.g., managing contacts, workflows) via Rube MCP. It must first search for current tools using RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS, check connection status with RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS, then execute with RUBE_MULTI_EXECUTE_TOOL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to automate operations in Affinity (e.g., creating contacts, updating organizations). The skill will automatically search tools, verify connection, and execute the task.

say_en.text: Automate creating a contact in Affinity.
say_en.note: Will search tools first then execute.

say_en.text: Batch update organization info in Affinity.
